titulo: The Modifiable Areal Unit Problem, CATMOG 38

localizador: Resumen, pp. 1–3 y sección retórica pp. 10–11.

localizador: Statistical Methodology pp. 6–9; Likelihood Ratio Test pp. 16–17; P-Value y repeated analyses pp. 64–66.

emisor: Aaron Clauset, Cosma R. Shalizi, M. E. J. Newman / SIAM Review

titulo: Growth, innovation, scaling, and the pace of life in cities
